gen.title: From revising the old system to debating a new frame
gen.orderNote: Order follows the text as the meeting moves from revising to creating

steps.label: convened in the State House
steps.quote: The Federal Convention convened in the State House (Independence Hall) in Philadelphia on May 14, 1787, to revise the Articles of Confederation.
steps.orderHint: Follow the opening of the meeting

steps.label: adjourned from day to day
steps.quote: the members adjourned from day to day until a quorum of seven states was obtained on May 25
steps.orderHint: Notice the wait for enough states to begin

steps.label: entirely new frame of government
steps.quote: it became clear by mid-June that, rather than amend the existing Articles, the Convention would draft an entirely new frame of government
steps.orderHint: See why a new plan replaced a revision

steps.label: delegates debated
steps.quote: All through the summer, in closed sessions, the delegates debated, and redrafted the articles of the new Constitution.
steps.orderHint: Track the summer work in closed sessions

steps.label: how much power to allow the central government
steps.quote: how much power to allow the central government, how many representatives in Congress to allow each state
steps.orderHint: Look at the key issues that were debated
